mission: Sustain the lattice resonance while Desh disables Veraine's amplification array and Torin's competing technique threatens to overwhelm the harmonic.
why_now: Three simultaneous operations must execute: resonance trio at the wound, Desh at Veraine's amplification array, Torin's technique competing with the resonance. The climax is now.
conflict: Three interwoven conflicts — resonance vs. lattice, Desh vs. Veraine's equipment, Torin vs. himself
turning_point: Desh disables Veraine's amplification array. The resonance catches — the technique wins the sprint, the resonance wins the marathon. Ben stops trying to control it.
emotional_trajectory: Collective action is harder and slower but sustainable. The discipline to hold course.
notes: Veraine's ritual disrupted. Torin's technique effective but consuming him. Resonance catches after Ben stops trying to control it. The critical moment: technique wins the sprint, resonance wins the marathon.
